question: I want to know the IDs, names of weather stations within a 50 km straight-line distance from the center of Chicago (41.8319°N, 87.6847°W)
sql:
WITH chicago AS (
  SELECT 41.8319 AS lat, -87.6847 AS lon
),
stations_with_distance AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.latitude,
    s.longitude,
    -- Haversine distance in km using acos(-1) for pi
    6371.0 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        COS(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * COS(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180) *
        COS(acos(-1) * s.longitude / 180 - acos(-1) * chicago.lon / 180) +
        SIN(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * SIN(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180),
        1.0
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
  CROSS JOIN chicago
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  ROUND(distance_km, 2) AS distance_km
FROM stations_with_distance
WHERE distance_km <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km

    s.longitude,
    -- Haversine distance in km using acos(-1) for pi
    6371.0 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        COS(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * COS(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180) *
        COS(acos(-1) * s.longitude / 180 - acos(-1) * chicago.lon / 180) +
        SIN(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * SIN(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180),
        1.0
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
  CROSS JOIN chicago
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  ROUND(distance_km, 2) AS distance_km
FROM stations_with_distance
WHERE distance_km <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km
